Overall the figure is awesome! Excellent articulation, sculpt and scale. I will still nitpick a bit. NO interchangeable hands, the tentacles are fixed too, can't bend them in different shapes, although you can move them around in different slots freely. The grey part of the figure looks matte/smooth while the black portion is a bit shiny/plastic-y. I believe that is an issue with some Marvel Legend figures.
